days.title: Western Peaks and Passes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Corno d'Aquilio
stops.detail: The accesses to the highest part of the park are provided by the Passo della Liana road which climbs from Sant'Anna d'Alfaedo between Corno d'Aquilio and Corno Mozzo;

stops.name: passo delle Fittanze
stops.detail: the provincial road from Erbezzo to the Fittanze pass;
